q121.question: What are the fourteen known facts about personality, and what is meant by the three phases and the seven dimensions of personality?
q121.answer:
Here is a detailed account of the fourteen known facts about personality, the three phases of personality, and the seven dimensions of personality as described in Paper 112 (Personality Survival) of The Urantia Book.

1. The Fourteen Known Facts about Personality

[112:0.3 ~ 112:0.16]

A quality in reality: Personality is a quality in reality which is bestowed by the Universal Father himself or by the Conjoint Actor, acting for the Father. [112:0.3]

Bestowed upon energy systems: Personality can be bestowed upon any living energy system which includes mind or spirit. [112:0.4]

A relatively creative nature: Personality is not wholly subject to the fetters of antecedent causation; it is relatively creative or cocreative. [112:0.5]

Spirit's mastery through mind: When bestowed upon evolutionary material creatures, personality causes spirit to strive for the mastery of energy-matter through the mediation of mind. [112:0.6]

The unification of identity: Personality, while devoid of identity, can unify the identity of any living energy system. [112:0.7]

Qualitative response: Personality discloses only qualitative response to the personality circuit, in contrast to the energies, which show both qualitative and quantitative response to gravity. [112:0.8]

Changelessness amid change: Personality itself remains changeless and enduring in the presence of changes of environment and condition. [112:0.9]

A gift to God: Personality can make a gift to God by dedicating its free will to the doing of the will of God. [112:0.10]

Characterized by morality: Personality is characterized by morality, an awareness of the relativity of relationship with other persons; it discerns levels of conduct and discriminates between them by choosing. [112:0.11]

Absolute uniqueness: Personality is absolutely unique and without duplicate in time and space, in eternity and on Paradise. It is unique also in relation to God; personalities can be associated, but they cannot be totaled (added together). [112:0.12]

Direct response between personalities: Personality responds directly to the presence of other personality. [112:0.13]

Demonstrating the primacy of the Father: Personality is one thing which can be added to spirit, thus illustrating the primacy of the Father in relation to the Son. [112:0.14]

Survival beyond death: Personality may survive mortal death with identity in the surviving morontia soul. [112:0.15]

A unique time consciousness: Personality has a unique consciousness of time, which is something other than the time perception of mind or spirit. [112:0.16]

2. The Three Phases of Personality (Three Cosmic Phases)

[112:1.1 ~ 112:1.4]

Personality functions on three cosmic planes, or in three universe phases, ranging from the finite level even to the borders of the absonite and the absolute:

Position State (Position status): The phase in which personality functions equally efficiently in the local universe, in the superuniverse, and in the central universe. [112:1.2]

Meaning State (Meaning status): The phase in which personality performs effectively on the levels of the finite and the absonite, and even as impinging upon the absolute. [112:1.3]

Value State (Value status): The phase in which personality can be experientially realized in the progressive realms of the material, the morontial, and the spiritual. [112:1.4]

3. The Seven Dimensions of Personality

[112:1.5 ~ 112:1.10]

The type of personality bestowed upon human mortals has a potentiality of seven dimensions of self-expression or person-realization. These seven dimensions are realized on three levels, as follows:

Three dimensions on the finite level (3 Finite Dimensions):

Length: Represents the direction and nature of evolutionary progression, movement through space and according to time; it denotes meaning. [112:1.6], [112:1.10]

Vertical depth: Embraces the organismal drives and attitudes, the varying levels of self-realization, and reaction to environment; it signifies value. [112:1.7], [112:1.10]

Breadth: Embraces the domain of co-ordination, association, and selfhood organization; it embraces insight, the capacity to experience consciousness of cosmic reality. [112:1.8], [112:1.10]

Three dimensions on the absonite level (3 Absonite Dimensions): The three dimensions realized on the absonite level. [112:1.9]

One dimension on the absolute level (1 Absolute Dimension, the totality dimension): The seventh dimension is the totality dimension, which is experiencible on subabsolute levels as the fact of personality. It is the supreme dimension which, while not infinite, is dimensionally potential for subinfinite penetration of the absolute. [112:1.9]

q122.question: Please tell me in detail the known facts about the Solitary Messengers: their origin, characteristics, work, and so on.
q122.answer:
The origin, nature, characteristics, work, and cosmic mysteries of the Solitary Messengers, as explained in Paper 23 (The Solitary Messengers) of The Urantia Book and related passages, are as follows.

1. The Origin of the Solitary Messengers

Created by the Infinite Spirit alone: The Solitary Messengers are high spirit personalities of a senior order who came into existence through the first creative act of the Infinite Spirit (the Third Source and Center) acting alone, without the direct participation of the Universal Father or the Eternal Son. [23:0.1]

A single creation and a fixed number: The Solitary Messengers were personalized all at once in a single eternal creative episode, and their number is forever stationary; no more are created. [23:0.2], [23:3.9] Those operating within the jurisdiction of the superuniverse of Orvonton alone number almost 7,690 trillion, and this is conjectured to be considerably less than one seventh of their total number. [23:0.2]

The first time-conscious beings of the time-space universes: Apart from the Paradise and Havona circuits, they are among the oldest beings in the whole grand universe, and of the creations of the Infinite Spirit they were the first to be endowed with time consciousness within time and space. [23:1.1], [23:1.2]

2. Their Nature and Distinctive Characteristics

Formless spirits with full personality: They have no concrete physical or spirit form (appearance) that can be observed, but they possess complete, self-sufficient, self-conscious personality and a discernible spirit presence. [23:3.7], [42:12.10]

The enjoyment of working alone: As their name indicates, they enjoy traveling and serving independently and alone. [23:1.5] Yet they are not lonely beings; through the universe broadcasts and communication among messengers they are in constant touch with the intelligences of the whole grand universe. [23:1.5], [23:1.6]

An astonishing speed in traversing the universe:

Except for impersonal means such as the instantaneous Gravity Messengers, they have the greatest speed of all the personalities that actually traverse space. [23:3.2], [23:3.3]

Their speed varies with the conditions of the universe through which they travel, but according to the record cited in Paper 23, the highest speed recorded was 841,621,642,000 miles per second of Urantia time. [23:3.3]

An alarm mechanism against "short circuits": When two or more Solitary Messengers are in transit or in close proximity within the circuits of time and space, they are thrown out of liaison with the higher circuits and isolated; they are "short circuited." [23:1.9] They are therefore endowed with an automatic power of alarm that keeps them from such conflicts and keeps them sufficiently separated. [23:1.9]

The ability to detect divine spirit presences:

They are the only personalities able to detect and register the presence and number of the Inspired Trinity Spirits, mysterious beings of the Paradise Trinity. [19:5.5], [23:1.9]

They also automatically detect the presence of the Thought Adjusters, the fragments of the Paradise Universal Father who indwell the human mind. [19:5.6], [23:1.9]

Exemption from jurisdiction and antigravity endowment: They cannot be arrested or detained by the courts of time and space, and they are responsible only to the Seven Master Spirits. [23:1.7] As higher personalities of the Infinite Spirit, they are also endowed with tremendous antigravity powers. [24:0.10]

3. The Seven Service Assignments of the Solitary Messengers

The Solitary Messengers are not permanently attached to any particular individual or realm; they are freely shifted by the Infinite Spirit among seven divisions of service as need requires [23:2.1], [23:2.2], [23:2.10]:

Messengers of the Paradise Trinity: They carry the secret messages and unannounced policies of the Paradise Deities and keep their confidences perfectly. [23:2.11]

Messengers of the Havona circuits: They minister in close personal association with the natives of the central universe of Havona and with the ascending pilgrims. [23:2.13], [23:2.14]

Messengers of the superuniverses: As emissaries of the Ancients of Days, the rulers of the superuniverses, they are the only spirit intelligences able to travel directly to the headquarters of another superuniverse and communicate there without going by way of Havona. [23:2.15]

Messengers of the local universes: They faithfully represent the motives of the Creator Son and the local universe Mother Spirit and handle liaison between universes and between constellations. [23:2.18]

Explorers on undirected assignment: They set out voluntarily to explore the unknown regions of outer space beyond the grand universe, surveying and charting the locations of new energy centers and dark planets. [23:2.19], [23:2.20], [23:2.21]

Ambassadors and emissaries on special assignment: They set out at once for distant spheres that a seraphic ambassador would need hundreds of years to reach, and serve there as temporary ambassadors and emissaries. [23:2.22], [23:2.23]

Revelators of Truth: They are attached to commissions sent to enlarge the revelation of divine truth to the worlds and systems. [23:2.24]

4. Special Ministry and Eternal Cosmic Mystery

Co-ordinators of the personalities of spirit beings: They act as cosmic co-ordinators, helping the countless spirit personalities of differing origins and orders to understand one another and to develop a sense of kinship and group identity. [23:4.1]

Guardian-companions of the "children of time and eternity":

When an ascendant mortal (a finaliter) and a Paradise Citizen co-operate to trinitize a "⟦Q 23:4.3⟧child of time and eternity⟦/Q⟧" (a trinitized son), which involves unrevealed mind potentials, a Solitary Messenger is assigned as the permanent guardian-companion of this new son. [23:4.3]

This messenger is dispatched to the sphere of Vicegerington and placed under the supervision of the Architects of the Master Universe, and he never leaves there again. [23:4.3]

The riddle of cosmic exhaustion: Since the number of Solitary Messengers is forever fixed while the trinitization of creatures goes on without limit, it remains an eternal cosmic mystery who, or what new spiritual order, will take up their service in the grand universe when the supply of Solitary Messengers is exhausted in the remote future, and what the final destination will be of the pairs gathered on Vicegerington. [23:4.4]

q123.question: Regarding the functions of personality, please explain in detail the four levels of the self, the evolution of dominance, and the transfer of identity.
q123.answer:
According to Paper 112 (Personality Survival) of The Urantia Book and related passages, the functions of personality, the system of the self, the evolution of dominance, and the process of the transfer of identity are explained as closely connected, as follows.

1. The Functions of Personality and the Four Levels of the Self (Four Levels of Self)

In The Urantia Book personality has no identity of its own, but it is the exclusive bestowal of the Universal Father that unifies and integrates all the factors making up the self amid the changing experience of the creature. [0:5.11], [112:0.7]

In the study of selfhood, the four levels (systems) of the self under the functional control of personality form the following functional hierarchy [112:2.1-2.5]:

The Physical System (the body): the subordinate system

This is the living electrochemical organic mechanism made up of animal origin and hereditary endowment. [0:5.7] It serves as the lowest, material vehicle of the system of the self. [112:2.2]

The Intellectual System (the mind): the co-ordinate system

This is the mechanism that governs perception, thought, feeling, and consciousness. [0:5.8] Ministered to by the adjutant mind-spirits, it is the co-ordinate system and the arena in which meanings are recognized and choices are decided between the material world and the spiritual world. [12:8.11], [112:2.3]

Personality: the superordinate system

This is the superordinate cosmic endowment that integrates all the material, mindal, and spiritual factors of the self and confers volitional spontaneity, self-consciousness, and moral choice. [0:5.11], [112:2.4]

The Indwelling Spiritual Presence (the spirit): the potentially directive system

This is the Thought Adjuster, the prepersonal fragment of the Universal Father that indwells the mortal mind. [0:5.9] It points the way toward the spiritualization of the self and its immortal destiny. [112:2.5]

(Note: When spirit indwells the mortal mind and moral decisions are made, a new immortal morontia soul is born out of the relationship of mind and spirit as the enduring reality of the self. [0:5.10], [111:2.3])

2. The Evolution of Dominance

The Urantia Book explains that all personality, both human and superhuman, is characterized by an inherent cosmic quality called "⟦Q 112:2.15⟧the evolution of dominance⟦/Q⟧" [112:2.15]. This is the process of progressively expanding dominance and control not only over the drives within the self but over the whole external environment as well. [112:2.15]

Establishing the dominance of spirit: The central purpose of cosmic evolution is to move beyond the simple reactions of the material and animal self and to achieve spirit dominance (Spiritual Dominance) by voluntarily co-operating with the leading of the indwelling Thought Adjuster. [111:1.2], [112:2.15]

The two great phases of dominance of an ascending personality [112:2.16-2.18]:

Prefinaliter experience, the God-seeking experience: The stage of augmenting self-realization through the actualization of identity together with cosmic problem solving and universe mastery. [112:2.17]

Postfinaliter experience, the God-revealing experience: The stage, after perfection has been attained through ascension, of the creative expansion of self-realization through revealing the Supreme Being to lower intelligences who are still seeking God. [112:2.18]

Dominance in religion and in self-mastery: Evolutionary religion, which began with the fears and superstitious reactions of primitive man, progressively frees the self from its mechanical fetters through the ministry of the spirit of wisdom and the Thought Adjuster, and advances to the level of dominance found in "self-mastery" and spiritual liberty. [65:0.5], [86:6.6], [143:2.4]

3. The Transfer of Identity (Transfer of the Seat of Identity)

For a human being to pass from a transient existence in time and space to that of an eternally surviving universe being, a momentous work must take place: the transfer of the seat of identity. [112:2.20], [112:5.4]

The concept of transferring the seat of identity:

The mortal human being begins with the temporary seat of identity in the material body and material mind, the organismal life vehicle. [112:2.20], [112:5.4]

But since the material system is transient, the self must, through choice and decision, transfer the seat of identity from the material body to the immortal morontia soul born of co-operation with God, and later on to the status of spirit reality. [112:2.20], [112:5.4]

The mechanisms that bring about the transfer of identity:

Wholehearted choice of the free will: The sincere and steadfast decision to do the will of the Father in heaven is the free-will prerequisite that makes the transfer of identity possible. [112:2.20], [111:5.4-5.6]

Identification of identity with the morontia self: As the soul formed by choosing truth, beauty, and goodness during the mortal life grows, the self moves its seat from the circuits of the material mind to the reality of the morontia soul. [110:6.9], [111:3.2]

Resurrection and repersonalization after death: At the death of the body the material body is dissolved, but when the Thought Adjuster, who holds the memory, and the seraphic guardian, who conserves the soul's reality, are reunited in the resurrection halls of the mansion worlds, the human personality is clothed with a new morontia form and fully achieves the transfer of identity to the morontia self. [112:3.5], [112:5.16-5.19]

Eternal fusion with the Thought Adjuster (Adjuster Fusion): At a certain stage of the morontia ascent the Thought Adjuster and the immortal soul are completely and inseparably fused into one, and the transfer of identity is thereby fully confirmed as an eternal and indestructible divine actuality. [112:4.13], [112:7.1], [112:7.10]

q124.question: Please explain well, with examples, how the Conjoint Actor bestows personality on behalf of the Father.
q124.answer:
The first of the known facts about personality described in The Urantia Book, "⟦Q 112:0.3⟧La personnalité est cette qualité dans la réalité qui est conférée par le Père Universel lui-même, ou par l’Acteur Conjoint agissant pour le Père.⟦/Q⟧" [112:0.3], contains the heart of the technique of universe administration and creation.

According to The Urantia Book, the absolute source of personality is the Universal Father [5:6.3], and the Father personally presides over the personality circuit that embraces all personalities. [5:6.11] But because the Universal Father has limited himself and delegated every possible power to the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit [8:3.2], [10:3.17], the Conjoint Actor (the Infinite Spirit) also has the creative authority, acting for the Father, to bestow First Source personality or to personalize Third Source personalities. [9:8.10], [112:0.3]

Specific examples of the Conjoint Actor bestowing personality and personalizing beings on behalf of the Universal Father are as follows.

1. The Seven Master Spirits of Paradise

Background of their creation: They are the primary personalities who, soon after the Infinite Spirit came into existence, personalized with mathematical completeness the possibilities of association of the three Deities of the Paradise Trinity. [16:0.1], [16:0.10]

Bestowal on the Father's behalf: Acting for the Father, the Infinite Spirit brought the Seven Master Spirits into being as personalities, from Master Spirit Number One, who reflects the attributes of the First Source, to Master Spirit Number Seven, who reflects the whole Trinity, and gave them each the oversight of one of the seven superuniverses of the grand universe. [16:0.2], [16:2.4]

2. The Local Universe Mother Spirit (Creative Mother Spirit, the Divine Minister)

The technique of personalization: When a Creator Son (a Michael) leaves Paradise to create a local universe, he is accompanied by a creative spirit individualized from the Infinite Spirit. [34:0.1] Later, at the moment this creative spirit declares the intention of implanting life in space, a phenomenon called the "primary eruption" takes place on Paradise, and the hitherto impersonal spirit presence is personalized as a fully self-conscious personal spirit (Personal Spirit). [17:6.7], [34:1.1], [34:1.4]

Its meaning: Because the Conjoint Actor bestows personality on behalf of the Father, the Creative Mother Spirit comes to function as the personal mother of all living creatures in the local universe and as the full co-ordinate co-sovereign with the Creator Son. [33:3.6], [34:1.4]

3. The Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit

Solitary Messengers: They are the first high spirit personalities created by the Infinite Spirit alone, without the direct participation of the Universal Father or the Eternal Son. [23:0.1] Endowed with perfect self-consciousness and personality, they carry out confidential and emissary missions on the Father's behalf throughout the universe. [23:1.7], [23:3.3]

Administrative higher personalities: The Universe Circuit Supervisors, Census Directors, Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit, Associate Inspectors, Assigned Sentinels, and Graduate Guides who work throughout the superuniverses and the grand universe are directly bestowed with personality by the Infinite Spirit and serve accordingly. [24:0.2], [24:0.10]

4. The Messenger Hosts of Space

Universal Conciliators: These are spirit personalities who, when each superuniverse Master Spirit joins with the Power Directors in creating Havona Servitals, appear at the same time as a repercussion on the superuniverse headquarters worlds, fully formed and able to carry out judicial adjudication. [25:2.2]

Technical Advisers and Celestial Recorders: Numerous personal intelligences responsible for the spiritual and intellectual information and records of the whole grand universe are bestowed with personality and function under the initiative of the Conjoint Actor. [25:2.7-2.9], [30:2.74]

5. Third-Source Personalities

Personalities not of the Father's line: Besides the conventional personalities belonging to the Father's personality circuit, the Infinite Spirit personalizes Third Source personalities of its own class (for example, some of the Power Directors). [9:8.10], [9:8.11] These form a unique class of personality, personal to the Infinite Spirit but not unqualifiedly personal to creatures. [9:8.9], [9:8.11]

Summary

In the universal bestowal of his infinity and authority, the Universal Father has permitted the Conjoint Actor (the Infinite Spirit), acting for the Father, to personalize countless spirit personalities and to confer personal values upon the material, mindal, and spiritual systems of the grand universe. [8:3.2], [9:8.10], [12:8.13] Through this, the countless celestial beings born by the hand of the Infinite Spirit carry on the vast ministry of reaching out to evolving mankind and guiding it to the Paradise Father. [8:4.2], [9:8.25]

q125.question: What does it mean that personality has no identity of its own but unifies the identity of a system?
q125.answer:
The passage "⟦Q 112:0.7⟧Alors qu’elle est dépourvue d’identité, la personnalité peut unifier l’identité de tout système énergétique vivant.⟦/Q⟧" [112:0.7] means that personality itself does not directly possess any independent content of its own (body, memory, knowledge, and so on), but that it binds together the body, mind, and spirit, a system that is constantly changing in time and space, and establishes and maintains it as 'one self-conscious individual (identity).' [0:5.11], [112:0.7], [112:1.19]

Let me explain the specific meaning under three main points.

1. The Meaning of "Devoid of Identity"

Not an independent component: Personality itself does not contain the "contents of the system," such as independent memories, physical cells, or intellectual knowledge. [0:5.11], [112:1.18]

A bestowed cosmic endowment: Personality is a unique cosmic endowment and integrating framework which the Universal Father superimposes upon the living energy system (body + mind + spirit). [0:5.4], [0:5.11], [5:6.3]

Therefore there is no material or intellectual content that exists in personality taken by itself; only when it is joined with a living energy system does it function within that system. [0:5.4], [112:0.4]

2. The Meaning of "Unifies the Identity of a System"

Constantly changing factors: The "living energy system" called a human being consists of a physical system (the body), an intellectual system (the mind), and an indwelling spiritual system (the Thought Adjuster and the soul). [0:5.7-5.11], [112:2.1-2.5] During the earthly life the cells of the body are continually replaced, thoughts and feelings change, and spiritual experience keeps accumulating, so that the whole system is constantly changing. [1:7.4], [112:0.9], [112:5.20]

The establishment of integration and individuality: Even though all these factors are changing every moment, it is the function of personality to establish, and make enduring, the fact that 'the being undergoing all these changes is I myself (self-conscious identity).' [112:0.7], [112:0.9], [112:5.20] Personality unifies all the dynamic parts within the system and gives them a continuing identity. [112:1.19], [112:5.20]

3. Understanding Through a Simple Analogy

The living system: The bricks, steel reinforcement, glass, interior finishings, and electrical wiring that go into a building (consumable materials that are repaired and replaced over the years).

Personality: The architectural agent and integrating quality that keeps these materials from remaining scattered parts and establishes them with the unique identity and value of "one complete house."

The materials (body and mind) are not themselves personality, but through the bestowal of personality all the factors within the system are unified into one personal identity instead of falling apart. [112:1.17-1.19]

4. Application to Resurrection after Death and Eternal Survival

When the death of the body comes, the physical system (the body and the material mind) is dissolved, but the personality given by the Universal Father does not perish; it remains unchanged. [112:0.9], [112:0.15]

At the resurrection on the mansion worlds, this personality reunites the new morontia form (body), the conserved Thought Adjuster, and the surviving immortal soul, and so perfectly reassembles and restores the identity of 'the very same I who lived on earth.' [112:0.7], [112:5.16-5.20]

q126.question: In connection with the functions of personality, what does it mean that dimensional levels and spiritual levels are not co-ordinated?
q126.answer:
Paper 112, section 1, paragraph 12 of The Urantia Book states: "⟦Q 112:1.12⟧Beaucoup de difficultés éprouvées par les mortels dans leur étude de la personnalité humaine pourraient être évitées si la créature finie voulait se rappeler que les niveaux dimensionnels et les niveaux spirituels ne sont pas coordonnés dans la réalisation expérientielle de la personnalité.⟦/Q⟧." [112:1.12]

Here the statement that dimensional levels and spiritual levels "are not co-ordinated" means that the outward, intellectual, and functional dimensions of growth that personality displays in the time-space environment are not directly proportional, one to one, to the level of inner spiritual attainment, nor do they automatically move in step with it.

The specific meanings of this passage are as follows.

1. The Distinction between Dimensional Levels and Spiritual Levels

Dimensional Levels:

These are the measures of the organismal, intellectual, and functional dimensions in which personality reacts and expresses itself in the time-space environment.

On the finite level they include three dimensional factors: length (direction of progression, evolution, meaning), vertical depth (drives, attitudes, reaction to environment, value), and breadth (co-ordination, association, organization of self-consciousness, insight).

These correspond to the depth and breadth of physical and intellectual achievement, such as a person's intelligence, education, social and economic circumstances, and ability to organize ideas.

Spiritual Levels:

This is the degree of spiritual maturity: the attunement of faith with the indwelling Thought Adjuster (the Father's spirit), moral and spiritual choices directed toward God, and the progressive removal of selfishness from love.

2. Three Key Meanings of "Not Co-ordinated"

① The Lack of Proportion between Intellectual and Physical Endowment and Spiritual Progress

A person's high intellectual ability or high achievement in the dimensions of time and space (dimensional levels) does not automatically raise his spiritual level.

Likewise, even if a person's dimensional level is limited by low intellectual endowment or by a lack of social and cultural advantages, the possibility of seeking God within and progressing spiritually is exactly the same for every mortal.

The two levels, therefore, are not in a relationship of direct, interlocking co-ordination; they operate as separate cosmic axes.

② Independence from the Finite Limitations of Time and Space

In the finite material world there is always a temporary discrepancy (a time lag) in which the amount of knowledge a person has or the breadth of his dimensional experience does not match the purity of his inner faith and the level of his spiritual communion with God.

The time-space trials of life and the intellectual limitations a person experiences cannot become obstacles on the path of spiritual growth; spiritual progress is achieved regardless of the varied environmental differences of the evolutionary worlds.

③ Complete Harmony Achieved Only on the Morontia Level

In the finite material world there are time lags and differences between the dimensional levels and the spiritual levels, but the situation changes after the material life is finished and one ascends to the morontia level.

On reaching the morontia level, through the influence of morontia mota and the contribution of morontia mathematics, these expanded dimensional experiences at last come into perfect and wonderful harmony with the supreme dimension, the dimension of personality, and with spiritual values.

3. Lessons for the Study of Personality and for Life

Understanding this principle helps prevent errors commonly made in evaluating human personality:

A person's spiritual worth should not be judged by outward endowments or intelligence: Abundant knowledge or outstanding logical depth (dimensional level) does not necessarily make a person spiritually outstanding; on the contrary, even an unlearned and simple person may possess the highest spiritual insight.

It demonstrates the spiritual equality of all human beings: The genetic, environmental, and intellectual dimensions of human beings belong only to the dimensional realm, while the opportunity and value of spiritual growth before God are bestowed with absolute equality upon all mankind.

q127.question: What does it mean that the universe fact of God's becoming man has forever changed all the meanings of human personality?
q127.answer:
The sentence you have cited is a key proposition about personality recorded in Paper 112, section 2, paragraph 7 of The Urantia Book [112:2.7]: "⟦Q 112:2.7⟧The universe fact of God's becoming man has forever changed all meanings and altered all values of human personality⟦/Q⟧."

This passage explains in depth how the cosmic event of the earthly incarnation (Incarnation) of Christ Michael (Jesus) fundamentally reformed and changed the worth and character of the human being and the very nature of love.

Let me explain in detail the meaning of these words, and "how it changed" things, under three key dimensions.

1. The Values Changed by the Universe Fact of God's Becoming Man (How It Changed Them)

In the past man was often regarded as an insignificant and transient material creature, like dust in the vast universe, or as a worthless being bound under the wrath and law of God. [1:6.1], [103:2.9] But the cosmic fact that a Creator Son lived on earth clothed in the very flesh and blood of mortal man has completely changed the meaning of human existence. [2:1.7], [120:2.8]

Proof of the transcendent value of human personality: The fact that God (the Creator Son) himself took on a human body and lived a mortal life shows that the human being is by no means merely a chance product of the animal. [2:1.7], [129:3.6] The human body and human personality have been proclaimed to the whole universe as able to be indwelt by the spirit of the infinite Universal Father, and moreover as having the holy possibility of "divine sonship," of becoming eternally one with God. [1:4.2], [12:7.9], [194:3.5]

A change in the relationship between God and man (from Judge to loving Father): Because God himself experienced human life from the bottom up [129:4.5], man came to accept God not as a fearsome judge or a monarch demanding payment but as an intimate "Universal Father" who deeply sympathizes with and loves mortals in their weaknesses and struggles. [2:6.6], [174:1.3], [188:4.8]

A reinterpretation of the meaning of man to the universe intelligences: Michael's incarnation demonstrated and reinterpreted, to the myriads of celestial beings and to the whole universe, how sublime a divine fruit and spiritual value the material human beings of a backward planet can bear when they choose to do the will of God. [120:2.8], [186:5.6]

2. The True Nature of Love: Mutual Regard between Whole Personalities

This passage defines love not as a mere emotional impulse or sympathy but as "⟦Q 112:2.7⟧mutual regard of whole personalities⟦/Q⟧" [112:2.7].

A relationship of personality to personality: Between impersonal things or mere emotions there are only reactions; true fellowship or love cannot exist there. [1:7.1] True love and communion are possible only between beings who have personality. [1:7.1], [1:7.3]

The same law of love between God and man: When God loves man, it is not a passive pity that merely looks kindly on a creature; he respects and loves each human being as a unique and precious whole personality without duplicate in the universe. [12:7.9] Likewise, when man loves God or loves his fellow man, true love comes into being only when it rests on an attitude of mutual regard, respecting the other not as a part but as one whole and dignified personality. [147:4.9], [180:5.8]

3. The Partial Functioning of the Self and the Co-ordinated Focusing of the Whole Personality

The parts of the self (Selfhood), rational thinking, emotional feeling, and volitional wishing, can each function individually as parts of the self. [112:2.7] But such partial functioning alone cannot achieve "intelligent action" (Intelligent action) of cosmic meaning.

Personality as the superordinate unifier: The physical system (body) or the intellectual system (mind) of the self may produce fragmentary impulses, but the only superordinate agent that binds all these factors together, co-ordinates them, and unifies them is "personality" (Personality). [112:0.7], [112:2.4], [112:2.7]

Focusing and union in unselfish love: When a human being decides to love another being sincerely and unselfishly, the co-ordinated attributes of mind and will are wholly united with the spiritual endowment of the indwelling Thought Adjuster (the Father's spirit) and are focused and expressed in cosmic and moral action of the highest order. [16:7.4], [112:2.7], [196:3.20]

Summary

"⟦Q 112:2.7⟧The universe fact of God's becoming man⟦/Q⟧" has forever raised man's worth from that of a lowly creature to that of a divine son of God [2:1.7], [12:7.9], and it reveals that love is not a fragmentary emotion but a personal fellowship in which God and man, and man and man, fully respect one another as independent and dignified personalities. [1:7.1], [112:2.7] And this very decision to love is the intelligent driving force that co-ordinates all the capacities of the human self and enables it to live the noblest divine life. [112:2.7], [140:4.8]

q128.question: Please tell me in detail about the origin, characteristics, and work of the Mighty Messengers.
q128.answer:
The details of the origin, nature, characteristics, and principal duties of the Mighty Messengers described in The Urantia Book are as follows.

1. The Origin of the Mighty Messengers (Origin)

Of ascending mortal origin: The Mighty Messengers are Thought Adjuster-fused ascending mortals who started out from the evolutionary planets of time and space and reached Paradise.

The test of loyalty and the conditions of their selection: They were chosen because, during their ascending careers, when faced with universe rebellion or a grave crisis, they proved their cosmic loyalty steadfastly and unshakably in the face of the disloyalty of their superiors, or because they effectively prevented crises of error and sin.

The Trinity embrace (trinitization): After passing through Havona as pilgrims of time and entering the Corps of the Finality on Paradise, they are embraced in the secret embrace of the Paradise Trinity and newly personalized as the first order of the Trinitized Sons of Attainment.

Number and assignment: They are embraced by the Paradise Trinity in classes of seven hundred thousand at a time, one hundred thousand being assigned to each of the seven superuniverses. In the seventh superuniverse, Orvonton (headquarters on Uversa), almost one trillion Mighty Messengers are now commissioned and serving.

2. Their Nature and Characteristics (Characteristics)

Experiential understanding and merciful ministry: The Mighty Messengers vividly remember the whole of their past mortal lives, in which they themselves went through the weakness, fears, and trials of the material flesh and rose up from them. For this reason they are merciful and useful ministers who understand and sympathize most deeply with the evolutionary creatures of time and space.

The status of completed creatures: Having received the Trinity embrace, they function as "completed creatures" who have attained a stage of spiritual growth appropriate to the present universe age; their status is fixed, and they are permanently assigned to superuniverse service.

Co-operation with celestial beings: When they travel or minister, they are escorted by tertiary supernaphim, offspring of the Reflective Spirits, and wherever a Mighty Messenger functions, the Gravity Messengers are always under the messenger's direction.

3. Their Work and Principal Duties (Roles & Functions)

Official observers for the Ancients of Days: As official observers for the Ancients of Days, the rulers of the superuniverses, they are stationed at the superuniverse headquarters (Uversa), at the major and minor sector headquarters, at the local universe headquarters, and on important individual planets, serving as wise counselors to the authorities governing those realms.

Defenders in the superuniverse courts (Defenders): When individual mortals or planets come up for judgment or evaluation in the superuniverse tribunals, they serve as expert defenders who uphold and represent their case.

Revelators of Truth (Revelators of Truth): They are dispatched on special commissions to enlarge and spread the revelation of divine truth to particular worlds and systems of space (several important papers of the Urantia Papers were in fact revealed and written by Mighty Messengers).

Precise evaluation of origins and status: In the superuniverse government they work with the seconaphim to evaluate and adjust, accurate to the minute, the background of origin, the ancestral factors, and the actual state of spiritual growth of every being.

Deliberations of the ascendant trinitized commissions: Together with their fellow beings, Those High in Authority and Those without Name and Number, they form ascendant commissions which give final consideration to, and adjust, complex cases and differences of opinion on the spiritual level where the viewpoint of the mortal creature and the attitude of Deity come closest together.

q129.question: Please explain in detail what the Thought Adjuster does when a human being goes straight to the mansion worlds right after death.
q129.answer:
When a mortal has earned individual ascension status on earth (by reaching the third psychic circle or above, or by being assigned a personal guardian of destiny) and is resurrected on the mansion worlds immediately after death (on the third day after death), the specific course and procedure followed by the indwelling Thought Adjuster are as follows.

1. Release from the Earthly Body and Preservation of the Spiritual Memory

Separation from the body: At the moment of physical death, when the measurable human brain pulsations and the activity of the mind mechanism cease, the Thought Adjuster is immediately released from the earthly tabernacle and departs [112:3.4].

Preservation of the spiritual transcript of the human: Unlike the material human brain, the Adjuster departs holding perfectly within its own eternal reality the spiritual transcript (duplicate) of the spiritual values, meanings, moral character, and eternal memory that the human accumulated during the earthly life [112:3.5], [112:4.2], [108:6.5].

2. Release from Superuniverse (Uversa) Registration and Transit to Paradise

Crossing the universe by the gravity circuit: The Adjuster traverses space instantaneously by way of the universal material-gravity circuit of Paradise [107:6.4].

Release of the observer number at Uversa: In the course of this transit, the registration of its earthly assignment as observer, which had been recorded by a fixed number at Uversa, the superuniverse headquarters, and with the local universe authorities, is officially released [112:4.1].

3. Return to Divinington, Audience with the Father, and Recognition

Arrival at the home sphere of Divinington: The Adjuster arrives at once at Divinington, the Paradise rallying sphere of the Father fragments, and goes through the process of registration [112:4.3], [112:4.13].

Audience in the presence of the Universal Father: After registering at Divinington, the Adjuster proceeds directly into the personal presence of the Universal Father on Paradise [112:4.13].

Embraced by the Personalized Adjusters and recognized: Having been in the Father's presence, the Adjuster is embraced by the Personalized Adjusters of the superuniverse and local universe of its assignment and receives the final formal recognition of the chief Personalized Monitor of Divinington [112:4.13].

Entering the state of the "⟦Q 112:4.13⟧realization of identity transition⟦/Q⟧": Having passed through this process, the Adjuster enters the state called the "⟦Q 112:4.13⟧realization of identity transition⟦/Q⟧," in which it prepares for the resurrection reunion with the earth mortal [112:4.13].

4. Descent to the Resurrection Hall of the Mansion World and the Reassembly of the Personality (Repersonalization)

Arrival on the mansion world in the third period: In accordance with the resurrection mandate of the Ancients of Days and the sovereign tribunals of Nebadon, the Adjuster descends on the third day after death to the resurrection hall of the first mansion world [112:4.12-4.13], [49:6.9].

The reunion of three factors:

the immortal morontia soul that the seraphic guardian of destiny has kept in custody [112:3.5], [112:5.19],

the morontia form (new body) newly prepared by the morontia authorities and the Life Carriers [112:5.17],

and the Thought Adjuster carrying the transcript of spiritual memory and character are united once again [112:5.18-5.19].

Restoration of consciousness and identity: As the Thought Adjuster connects the spiritual memory it has kept with the new morontia mind, the awakening mortal recognizes that he is the very same human being who lived on earth, and regains full consciousness of identity [112:5.19-5.21].

5. Companionship on the Mansion Worlds and Eternal Adjuster Fusion

Continuous guardianship on the ascending path: Even during the transit sleeps between one mansion world and the next, the Thought Adjuster does not leave the mortal but accompanies him fully [47:4.4].

Adjuster fusion: When, during the sojourn on the mansion worlds or at the system capital, the mortal will wholly chooses to do the will of God, the Thought Adjuster and the morontia soul are forever joined as one in Adjuster fusion [112:7.1], [112:7.3-7.4]. Through this fusion the Adjuster and the human become an eternal, immortal ascending being who can never be separated, and they continue the eternal journey toward the Paradise Corps of the Finality [112:7.10-7.12].

q130.question: How do the seraphic guardian and the Thought Adjuster divide their roles in the resurrection hall on the third day, and what does the "new universe name" received after Adjuster fusion signify?
q130.answer:
1. The Division of Roles Between the Seraphic Guardian and the Thought Adjuster in the Resurrection Hall on the Third Day

When the human personality is reassembled (repersonalized) in the resurrection hall of the first mansion world on the third day after death, the seraphic guardian and the Thought Adjuster divide their roles as follows in divine co-operation:

The role of the seraphic guardian (guardian of destiny): custody of the soul and bestowal of the morontia form (body)

Custodian of the morontia soul: The seraphic guardian serves as the trustee who safely keeps the immortal morontia soul, which survives the death of the body, together with the passive potential of identity.

Uniting with the new body (morontia form): In the life-assembly chambers of the resurrection hall, working with the morontia authorities and the Life Carriers, the guardian seraphim bestows the reality of the morontia soul she has kept upon the newly prepared morontia form (morontia body) and enfolds it.

Reunion and introduction: The seraphim introduces the awakened personality once again to the descended Thought Adjuster, carrying forward the continuity of the personality from its earthly days.

The role of the Thought Adjuster (the spirit of the Father): restoration of spiritual memory and identity

Preservation of spiritual memory and character: The Thought Adjuster descends to the resurrection hall by way of Divinington, holding within its own reality all the spiritual values, moral character, spirit-mind elements, and the transcript of spiritual memory that the human acquired during the earthly life.

Reconnecting the circuits of consciousness and awakening identity: As the Adjuster again indwells the soul reality clothed in the morontia form, it connects the spiritual memory and character it has preserved directly to the newly segregated morontia mind and circuits of consciousness. In this way the awakening mortal realizes that he is the very same human being who lived on earth.

The full completion of repersonalization (resurrection)

The reassembly of the personality is completed when the morontia soul and body guarded by the seraphim, the spiritual identity and memory kept by the Adjuster, and the personality bestowed by the Universal Father are joined together once more.

2. The Meaning of the "New Universe Name" Given After Adjuster Fusion

Identification by number on earth and the bestowal of a new name at fusion

On earth a human being is called by a name, but in the celestial records (of the superuniverse, Divinington, and elsewhere) he is chiefly recognized and kept track of by the registry number of his indwelling Thought Adjuster.

But at the moment when, on the mansion worlds or during the morontia ascent, the mortal will decides to do the will of God forever and the eternal oneness with the Adjuster (Adjuster fusion) is confirmed, a new universe name is officially announced by the personal seraphic guardian, and the new being is introduced to his fellows by that new name.

Three key meanings of the "new universe name"

Establishing an independent and eternal universe identity: It symbolizes official recognition that the person is no longer a creature bound to a transient material planet, but a true immortal son of God the Father who will never perish throughout the whole grand universe.

The official cancellation of the Adjuster's number: Because the mortal soul and the Thought Adjuster are forever and inseparably fused, the former Adjuster number is canceled in the superuniverse records, and the new designation of a single, perfectly unified ascending God-man personality is entered.

The pledge of eternal sonship on the way to the Paradise Corps of the Finality: This new name signifies that the eternal ascending path toward the Paradise Corps of the Finality is assured. After receiving it, the believer is granted forty days of spiritual retirement, a spiritual commemoration in which he personally chooses his route to Paradise attainment.

q131.question: What is the future ministry in outer space in which we will take part as members of the Corps of the Finality after Adjuster fusion, and what is the process of passing through the "seven circuits of Havona" on the path of Paradise ascension?
q131.answer:
The future universe ministry in outer space in which we will take part as members of the Corps of the Finality after Adjuster fusion, and the process of passing through the "seven circuits of Havona" on the journey of Paradise ascension, form one of the most majestic and sublime conclusions of the Urantia revelation.

1. The Future Ministry of the Corps of the Finality in Outer Space After Adjuster Fusion

1) Admission to the Corps of the Finality and the present universe status

The finality oath and admission to the primary corps: The ascending mortal who became forever one with the Thought Adjuster on earth (a Father-fused mortal) passes through Havona and on Paradise spiritually finds and recognizes the Universal Father [14:5.4], [30:4.31]. Then, after taking the oath of finality that pledges eternal loyalty to the Paradise Trinity, he is formally mustered as a permanent member of the primary Corps of Mortal Finaliters [31:0.1], [112:7.15].

The role in the present universe age: At present the finaliters remain in the status of sixth-stage spirits and carry on administrative, educational, and auxiliary work as they circulate throughout the grand universe (the seven superuniverses) and among the worlds settled in light and life [30:4.32], [31:0.10-0.11], [31:3.3-3.4].

2) The future ministry in outer space

Pioneering the vast galaxies of outer space: Beyond the present borders of the seven superuniverses (the first through the fourth outer space levels), new physical universes and galaxies of stupendous size, many times larger than the grand universe, are being formed under the Master Architects [12:1.14], [12:2.6], [31:9.6-9.9]. The assembling mortal Corps of the Finality is destined to serve as the chief administrators who will govern and operate precisely these unknown worlds of outer space [31:0.8], [31:10.19], [112:7.17].

Attaining the seventh stage of spirit and God the Supreme: When the finaliters go forth into this as yet unrevealed ministry in outer space, they will at last attain the status of the seventh stage of spirit, the highest level of spirit attainment, and will directly serve and reveal the completed actuality of the experiential Deity, the Supreme Being [31:3.4-3.5], [56:8.2].

Compensating for the experiential deficiency of the creatures of outer space: The creatures who will appear in the outer space of the future will come into being without having passed through the evolutionary trials of time and space or having had the opportunity to participate directly in the evolution of the Almighty Supreme [31:10.11], [117:2.7]. The mortal finaliters, who began at the lowly bottom of the material worlds and climbed all the way to the heights of Paradise, joyfully overcoming every kind of failure, frustration, and adversity, will serve as wise teachers and rulers who fully compensate for this experiential deficiency of the beings of outer space and lead them onward [31:10.13], [56:8.2], [117:2.6].

Rule as a perfect union of Creator and creature: Because the finaliters are a perfect fusion of the personalized spirit of the Father (the Adjuster) and an eternalized human personality, they possess both divine nature and creature nature, and so they will be matchless leaders with the widest sympathy and understanding toward the new intelligent beings of outer space [112:7.17-7.18].

2. The Process of Passing Through the "Seven Circuits of Havona" on the Path of Paradise Ascension

The billion perfect spheres of Havona are arranged in seven concentric circuits around the stationary Isle of Paradise [12:1.4], [14:1.9]. The pilgrim who has completed the superuniverse ascent begins in the outermost circuit and goes through a progressive process of revelation and training as he advances to the innermost circuit [14:3.4], [26:3.1-3.2].

1) Arrival in Havona and reception

The spirit pilgrim who has completed the superuniverse ascent, enfolded by a primary seconaphim transport personality, alights alone on the receiving world (pilot world) of the seventh circuit, the outermost of Havona [14:5.4], [26:4.11-4.12], [30:4.27].

At this point the pilgrim is admitted safely at the invitation of the Paradise Deities, possessing only one proven perfection, the perfection of purpose [26:4.12-4.13].

2) The step-by-step passage circuit by circuit (seventh circuit to first circuit)

The seventh circuit (foundations and the pilgrim helpers):

Under the guidance of the pilgrim helpers of the secondary supernaphim, the pilgrim enters the foundational course in the Havona system and in spiritual insight [26:5.1-5.2].

When he successfully achieves the spiritual recognition of the Master Spirit of his native superuniverse, he is recognized as a "spiritual graduate" and advances to the sixth circuit [26:5.5], [26:6.1].

The sixth circuit (awareness of the divinity of the Supreme Being):

Under the direct supervision of the supremacy guides, the pilgrim comes to a deep awareness of the spiritual reality and sovereignty of God the Supreme, the almighty unifying source of the creations of time and space [26:6.1-6.2].

After examination by the commission of seventy, he goes on to the fifth circuit [26:6.4].

The fifth circuit (Trinity instruction and attainment of the Infinite Spirit):

Under the guidance of the Trinity guides, the pilgrim takes the classic instruction concerning the divine Trinity and passes through genuine spiritual struggle [26:7.1].

When he succeeds in the personality recognition and attainment of the Infinite Spirit, the Third Source and Center, he moves on to the fourth circuit [26:7.5-7.6].

The fourth circuit (the circuit of the Sons and attainment of the Eternal Son):

Led by the Son finders, the pilgrim achieves spiritual contact with the Eternal Son, and on the worlds of this circuit he meets the Paradise Michaels in person and deepens mutual understanding [26:8.1]. He attains the Eternal Son, the Second Source and Center [14:5.4].

The third circuit (the Father guides and the finding of the Universal Father):

Under the tutelage of the most experienced Father guides, the pilgrim masters the wisdom and techniques of the central universe [26:9.1].

As the supreme moment of eternity attainment, he passes through the eternal gateway of spiritually finding and recognizing in person the Universal Father, the source of all things [14:5.4], [26:9.2-9.3].

The second circuit (preparation for the eternal career and divine fellowship):

Under the guidance of the counselors and advisers, the pilgrim refines his attitude toward the new order of universe responsibilities he will receive after arriving on Paradise and toward the eternal career [26:10.1], [26:10.6].

The first circuit (final reception and the last sleep of time):

In this innermost circuit the pilgrim sojourns with the complements of rest and enjoys deep fellowship with the many kinds of personalities of Paradise society [26:11.1], [26:11.3].

Through the ministry of the instigators of rest of the primary supernaphim, he falls into the final transit slumber (the last sleep of time) that forever crosses all the limits of time and space, and when he opens his eyes he is resurrected on the eternal shores of Paradise as a fully eternalized child of God [26:11.6-11.7], [27:1.1-1.4].

q132.question: What are the "seven jubilee celebrations" on Paradise that the finaliters experience after taking the Trinity oath of eternity, and what is the mystery of the absonite level governed by the Master Architects of the Master Universe?
q132.answer:
The details of the "seven jubilee celebrations" that the ascending mortal experiences after completing the Trinity oath of eternity on Paradise, and of the "mystery of the absonite level" over which the Master Architects of the Master Universe preside, are as follows.

1. The "Seven Jubilee Celebrations" of the Mortal Ascender

In the course by which a lowly mortal of an earthly planet passes through the eternal ascending journey and reaches the heights of Paradise and the Corps of the Finality, seven jubilee celebrations are held, symbolizing spiritual victories and achievements [27:7.8].

The first jubilee [27:7.8]

The spiritual decision on earth: It commemorates the moment when the mortal, during the material life, established the wholehearted purpose to seek God and do his will, and so sealed an eternal agreement with the indwelling Thought Adjuster (the spirit of the Father).

The second jubilee [27:7.8]

The morontia resurrection: It commemorates the moment of resurrection, when on the third day after the death of the body, in the resurrection hall of the first mansion world, the mortal puts on a new morontia form (a new body) and takes the first step of the eternal career.

The third jubilee [27:7.8]

Adjuster fusion: It commemorates the divine union in which, on the morontia path of ascent, the mortal will was fully proved and the indwelling Thought Adjuster and the immortal morontia soul were joined as one, eternally and inseparably.

The fourth jubilee [27:7.8]

Entrance into Havona: It commemorates the moment when, having completed the pilgrimage through the seven superuniverses and crossed the limits of space, the pilgrim arrived at the pilot world of the outermost circuit of Havona, the central universe, and awoke to the life of Havona.

The fifth jubilee [27:7.8]

Finding the Universal Father in person: It celebrates the eternal achievement of spiritually finding and personally contacting the Universal Father of Paradise, the origin and Creator of all things, while passing inward through the seven circuits of Havona.

The sixth jubilee [27:7.8]

Entrance into Paradise: It commemorates the moment when, after falling into the final transit slumber of time (the sleep of the last transformation) on the first circuit of Havona, the pilgrim passed beyond time and space and awoke on the shores of the eternal Isle of Paradise as a fully eternalized child of God.

The seventh jubilee [27:7.8]

Admission to the Corps of the Finality and the beginning of eternity service: It celebrates the completion of the eternal oath of finality to the Paradise Trinity, formal admission as a member of the primary Corps of Mortal Finaliters, and the beginning of eternal universe service.

The extension into the jubilees of eternity: Later, when a mortal finaliter, after service in the universes of time and space, rises to the status of the seventh stage of spirit, the highest level of spiritual attainment, this becomes the great universe signal announcing that the first of the jubilees of eternity, which will unfold in the endless future, has begun [27:7.8], [31:3.4].

2. The Master Architects of the Master Universe and the Mystery of the Absonite Level

1) What is the "absonite level"?

The transcendence of time and space: The absonite level is a level of universe reality greater than the finite (which has a beginning and the limits of time and space) and less than the absolute (which has neither beginning nor end and no space) [0:1.11], [0:1.12]. It is a transcendental realm that exists without beginning or ending but is not complete absoluteness [0:1.12].

The technique of eventuation: Unlike finite creatures, who are "created," absonite beings are characterized by coming into existence by "eventuating" directly from the divine potential of Deity [0:1.12], [30:1.92].

2) The Master Architects of the Master Universe

The supreme governing corps of the order of Transcendentalers: The Master Architects of the Master Universe are made up of 28,011 absonite personalities in all and are the supreme directing body of the group of Paradise Transcendentalers [31:9.1].

The Senior Architect: The Senior Architect, the first to be eventuated, is the senior chief who co-ordinates all the Paradise intelligences of the grand universe and the master universe below the level of God [31:9.1], [31:9.3].

3) The seven absonite space levels and the structure of the corps of 28,011

The Master Architects function in precise subdivisions according to the seven space levels of the master universe (Paradise, Havona, the superuniverses, and the first through fourth outer space levels) as follows [31:9.2-31:9.10]:

First (the Paradise level): 1 (the Senior Architect), eventuated at the dawn of eternity, who co-ordinates Paradise and the twenty-one associated Paradise satellite spheres [31:9.3].

Second (the Havona level): 3, who co-ordinate the absonite plans of the billion perfect spheres of Havona, the central universe [31:9.4].

Third (the superuniverse level): 7, who function as absonite supercoordinators of the seven superuniverses (the grand universe) [31:9.5].

Fourth (the primary space level): 70, who formulate the ultimate plans for the pioneer universes of the first outer space level, lying beyond the outskirts of the seven superuniverses [31:9.6].

Fifth (the secondary space level): 490, who plan the galactic spheres of the second outer space level [31:9.7].

Sixth (the tertiary space level): 3,430, who plan the vast pioneer regions of the third outer space level [31:9.8].

Seventh (the quartan space level): 24,010, who plan the universes of the fourth and outermost outer space level [31:9.9].

(According to a Paradise tradition, there was an attempt at the eventuation of a 28,012th Architect, but a mysterious event took place: going beyond the limit of the absonite level and reaching the value of the Absolute, that personality was seized by the Universal Absolute [31:9.10].)

4) Three great universe mysteries directed by the Master Architects

Overall direction of the physical pioneering of outer space: In the unknown outer space beyond the grand universe, the Master Architects directly supervise and direct the primary eventuated master force organizers and the associate transcendental master force organizers, who transmute primordial force into physical energy [29:5.4], [31:9.12].

Custody of the "Sons of Destiny" sealed on Vicegerington: The "Sons of Destiny" (the children of time and eternity), brought into being through the joint trinitization of an ascending mortal (finaliter) and a Paradise-Havona native, together with their guardian companions the Solitary Messengers, are placed under the exclusive supervision of the Master Architects alone; they are gathered and preserved on the Paradise sphere of Vicegerington, awaiting the universe ages of the future [22:7.10], [23:4.3].

The formation of the Ultimate Trinity and the future rule of the master universe: Together with the Supreme Creators and the completed Supreme Being, the Architects make up the "Ultimate Trinity" of the absonite level [106:3.2]. Beyond the present grand universe age, when all of the unknown outer space has been completed as inhabited universes, they are destined to be the universe leaders who will unify and lead the whole master universe of the future on the absonite level [0:9.1], [31:10.10], [106:4.2].
